text:
maria: Escalation — Dedicated customer (pool D-12, us-east-1) reports SSE/text-streams cutting off after ~18s of inactivity. Client reconnects and sometimes gets a truncated/duplicated final chunk which is causing duplicate-token billing complaints. Repro steps below and trace_id trc-20260314-58a1.

ryan: Can you paste the gateway trace + envoy logs? Do we know if traffic is HTTP/2 between Cloudflare -> ALB -> gateway? Also whether ALB or NLB is in front?

maria: Attached a trimmed trace and the gateway snippets (see below). Customer fronting with Cloudflare (http/2 to ALB) -> ALB (HTTP/1.1 to our gateway) -> envoy. ALB idle timeout set to 15s for that account. Repro command they used:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \\  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \\  --no-buffer \\  https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams/complete?trace_id=trc-20260314-58a1
```
Behavior: initial stream emits tokens ~every 200ms, then after ~18s no activity, connection resets mid-token (client sees partial last chunk), client reconnects and asks for resume; server emits remaining tokens again leading to duplicates. Gateway logs show upstream FIN shortly before reset and a TLS close on the ALB->gateway connection.

cloudbot: Note: ALB pool D-12 currently configured with target-group timeout 15s for that customer (prod config snapshot).

devin: Hypothesis: ALB/Cloudflare idle timeout + h2-to-h1 conversion is racing with our envoy keepalive semantics. ALB closes the tunnel (FIN) while Cloudflare still expects to translate/flush HTTP/2 frames to the client -> results in half-closed stream and Envoy emits RST_STREAM or half-close. Data can get buffered in CF/ALB, producing truncated chunks client-side.

Workarounds / immediate mitigations:
- Ask customer to force HTTP/1.1 to origin (curl with `--http1.1`) or disable CF HTTP/2-to-origin to remove translation layer.
- Disable proxy buffering on CF/ALB side (if possible) and increase ALB idle timeout to >= 120s for streaming clients.
- Implement small server-side heartbeat to keep connection alive: SSE serverspace can send a comment every 10s, e.g. `printf ": heartbeat\n\n"` to avoid idle close.

devin: Example nginx/proxy settings to avoid buffering and favor chunked passthrough:
```
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_set_header Connection "";
chunked_transfer_encoding on;
proxy_read_timeout 180s;
```

Also test repro forcing HTTP/1.1 from CF with `curl --http1.1` and check if truncation disappears. If it does, the CF->ALB h2->h1 conversion path is the culprit.

maria: Customer tried `--http1.1` and saw no truncation in a 30m test window — good signal. They've asked for a fix without changing their CF settings.

ingrid: I'll open an infra ticket to: (1) bump ALB idle timeout for that Dedicated pool D-12 to 120s, (2) add an optional per-customer proxy flag to disable buffering and enable chunked passthrough, and (3) schedule a small gateway change to emit a 1-byte SSE heartbeat (comment) every 10s for long-lived streams. ETA 48 hours for ALB change + config rollout.

ryan: For support reply: give the customer the `--http1.1` temp workaround, advise adding client-side dedupe by trace_id on reconnects, and say infra ETA 48h. Also ask them to share any client-side logs showing `ERR_STREAM_RESET` or similar.

maria: Sent those instructions to customer and included curl sample and heartbeat suggestion. Customer accepted temp workaround and will test with `--http1.1` now. Marking monitored — will update when infra ticket closes. :white_check_mark:

devin: One extra note: watch for duplicate billing if reconnects happen; we should add a short-term guard in the billing pipeline to dedupe tokens by trace_id when same request restarted within 2 minutes. Filing separate billing ticket.

maria: Thanks — keeping thread open until infra + billing tickets are closed.

cloudbot: (automated) infra-ticket INF-2026-112 created by ingrid for ALB/config changes.

ryan: Ack, moving to watching channel. :thumbsup:
